Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِىْ فَأَنْتَ أَعْظَمُ
Translation: O Allah, if my sins are great, You are greater
And if my negligence is vast, You are vaster
And if my miserliness persists, You are more generous

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ عَظِيمَ ذُنُوبِىْ بِعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive my great sins with Your great pardon
And my abundant negligence with Your manifest generosity
And suppress my miserliness with Your abundant grace

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
Translation: O Allah, whatever blessings we have are from You
There is no god but You
I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance
